children: ONE Gas will participate in the American Gas Association Mini-Forum on Sept. 15, 2026, with its CFO and treasurer meeting investment community members.
ONE Gas announced participation in the AGA Mini-Forum in Boston on Sept. 15, 2026, to engage industry stakeholders.
Christopher Sighinolfi (CFO) and Mark Smith (VP & treasurer) will conduct a series of investor meetings at the event.
Conference materials will be posted on ONE Gas’s investor events and presentations webpage for public access.
The disclosure is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and is not deemed “filed” under Section 18 of the Exchange Act.
